"""Explicit synthetic native QA probe; no Teams, physical sink or audio files.

Without --authorize-live this exits before config, DNS, synthesis or model start.
Run only in an already authorized runtime; offline tests inject all live I/O.
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import hashlib
import os
import re
import time
import subprocess
import tempfile
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from .b_native import NativeLiveResponder
from .b_response import GREETING, MeetingMinutesTool, MeetingStoreMinutesReader
from .browser import Browser
from .assistant_config import load_assistant_settings
from .media import load_ice_servers
from .meeting_store import MeetingStore
from .runtime_guard import RuntimeLiveGuard
from .owned_processes import OwnedProcesses
from .qa_rx_evidence import ProbeTrackOutput, answer_rx, owned_cleanup_verified

WORK_SECONDS = 120
CLEANUP_SECONDS = 10

WAKE = 'xiaobai xiaobai'
QUESTION = '請只用繁體中文逐字引用會議預算原文，不加說明。'
QUESTION_VOICE = 'cmn-latn-pinyin'


class WorkDeadlineExceeded(TimeoutError):
    pass


class PhaseWaitTimeout(TimeoutError):
    def __init__(self, seconds):
        self.seconds = seconds
        super().__init__('phase_wait_timeout')


class NoPhysicalSink:
    """Observe the owned no-PLC graph without connecting a physical audio sink."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.page = None
        self.owner = uuid.uuid4().hex

    async def attach_live(self, page):
        if self.page is not None:
            raise RuntimeError('probe_output_already_attached')
        self.page = page
        await page.evaluate("""owner => {
          const live=window.__live, noPlc=live?.noPlc;
          const receivers=live?.pc?.getReceivers().filter(r=>r.track?.kind==='audio') || [];
          if(receivers.length!==1 || live.qaOutput || !noPlc?.valid() ||
             noPlc.receiver!==receivers[0] || noPlc.inputTrack!==receivers[0].track)
            throw new Error('probe_receiver_unavailable');
          noPlc.track.enabled=false;
          const out=live.qaOutput={owner,live,receiver:receivers[0],noPlc};
          out.valid=()=>window.__live===live && live.qaOutput===out && live.noPlc===noPlc &&
            noPlc.valid() && noPlc.receiver===out.receiver && noPlc.inputTrack===out.receiver.track &&
            live.pc.getReceivers().includes(out.receiver);
        }""", self.owner)

    async def start(self):
        await self.set_muted(True)

    async def set_muted(self, muted):
        if muted is not True:
            raise RuntimeError('physical_output_forbidden')
        await self.page.evaluate("""owner => {
          const live=window.__live, out=live?.qaOutput;
          if(out?.owner!==owner || !out.valid()) throw new Error('probe_receiver_unavailable');
          out.noPlc.track.enabled=false;
        }""", self.owner)

    async def observe(self):
        return await self.page.evaluate("""owner => {
          const live=window.__live, out=live?.qaOutput;
          if(out?.owner!==owner || !out.valid() || out.noPlc.track.enabled)
            throw new Error('probe_receiver_unavailable');
          const {input,render}=out.noPlc.stats();
          return {connected:live.pc.connectionState==='connected',
            packets:input.packets,frames:render.frames,duration:render.duration,energy:render.energy,
            source_packets:input.packets,source_frames:input.frames,
            source_duration:input.duration,source_energy:input.energy};
        }""", self.owner)

    async def rx_snapshot(self):
        return await self.page.evaluate("""async owner => {
          const live=window.__live, out=live?.qaOutput;
          if(out?.owner!==owner || !out.valid() || out.noPlc.track.enabled)
            throw new Error('probe_receiver_unavailable');
          const report=await out.receiver.getStats();
          if(!out.valid() || out.noPlc.track.enabled) throw new Error('probe_receiver_unavailable');
          const rows=[...report.values()].filter(r=>r.type==='inbound-rtp' &&
            (r.kind==='audio'||r.mediaType==='audio') && r.isRemote!==true);
          if(rows.length>1) throw new Error('probe_receiver_ambiguous');
          const r=rows[0], {input,render}=out.noPlc.stats();
          if(!r && (input.packets!==0||input.frames!==0||input.duration!==0||input.energy!==0))
            throw new Error('probe_receiver_stats_missing');
          return {connected:live.pc.connectionState==='connected',
            inbound:r ? {ssrc:r.ssrc,packets_received:r.packetsReceived,bytes_received:r.bytesReceived} :
              {ssrc:null,packets_received:0,bytes_received:0},
            source:{packets:input.packets,frames:input.frames,duration:input.duration,energy:input.energy},
            render:{frames:render.frames,duration:render.duration,energy:render.energy}};
        }""", self.owner)

    async def pause(self):
        await self.set_muted(True)
        return {"status":"muted","truncated":False,"reason":"output_disabled"}

    async def stop(self):
        if self.page is None or self.page.is_closed():
            return
        await self.page.evaluate("""async owner => {
          const out=window.__live?.qaOutput;
          if(out?.owner===owner) {
            out.noPlc.track.enabled=false;
            out.noPlc.close();
            await out.noPlc.closing;
            if(out.live.qaOutput===out) delete out.live.qaOutput;
          }
        }""", self.owner)


def synthetic_phoneme_preflight():
    for text in ('請', QUESTION):
        raw = subprocess.run(['espeak-ng', '-q', '--ipa', '-v', QUESTION_VOICE, text],
            capture_output=True, timeout=10, check=True).stdout
        if not isinstance(raw, bytes) or not 0 < len(raw) <= 4096:
            raise ValueError('synthetic_mandarin_phonemes_invalid')
        try:
            phonemes = raw.decode('utf-8').strip()
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            raise ValueError('synthetic_mandarin_phonemes_invalid') from None
        if (not phonemes or re.search(r'\((?!cmn\))[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*\)', phonemes)
                or (text == '請' and re.sub(r'[\s0-9ˈˌ\u200c\u200d]', '', phonemes) != 'tɕhiŋ')):
            raise ValueError('synthetic_mandarin_phonemes_invalid')
    return True


def synthetic_pcm(text):
    if text not in (WAKE, QUESTION):
        raise ValueError('fixed_synthetic_input_required')
    if text == QUESTION:
        synthetic_phoneme_preflight()
    voice = subprocess.run(['espeak-ng', '--stdout', '-v', 'en' if text == WAKE else QUESTION_VOICE, text],
        capture_output=True, timeout=10, check=True).stdout
    pcm = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-nostdin', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error',
        '-i', 'pipe:0', '-t', '12', '-ar', '24000', '-ac', '1', '-f', 's16le', 'pipe:1'],
        input=voice, capture_output=True, timeout=10, check=True).stdout
    if not pcm or len(pcm) % 2 or len(pcm) > 576000 or not any(pcm):
        raise ValueError('synthetic_pcm_invalid')
    return pcm


async def wait_until(native, condition, timeout=45):
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
            while not condition():
                if native.error or native.state in {'failed', 'stop_unknown'}:
                    raise RuntimeError('qa_branch_failed')
                await asyncio.sleep(.02)
                if native.state not in {'sleeping', 'listening'}:
                    continue
                # Probe-only synthetic quiet; this is not physical captured input.
                ended_at = time.monotonic()
                if native.intervals.overlaps(ended_at - .02, ended_at):
                    continue
                if not native.push_rx(native.meeting_id, b'\0' * 960,
                        started_at=ended_at - .02, ended_at=ended_at):
                    raise RuntimeError('qa_pcm_rejected')

    except TimeoutError as error:
        raise PhaseWaitTimeout(timeout) from error


async def send_pcm(native, pcm):
    for offset in range(0, len(pcm), 2048):
        if native.error:
            raise RuntimeError('qa_branch_failed')
        chunk = pcm[offset:offset + 2048]
        ended_at = time.monotonic()
        if not native.push_rx(native.meeting_id, chunk,
                started_at=ended_at - len(chunk) / 48000, ended_at=ended_at):
            raise RuntimeError('qa_pcm_rejected')
        await asyncio.sleep(len(chunk) / 48000)


async def probe_rtp_snapshot(native, label, started, *, limit_seconds=.25):
    """One existing peer.stats read; fixed points, counts only, no polling."""
    row = {'point':label, 'received_seconds':time.monotonic() - started, 'read_status':'unavailable'}
    stats = getattr(getattr(native, 'peer', None), 'stats', None)
    if not callable(stats):
        return row
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(limit_seconds):
            raw = await stats()
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            row['read_status'] = 'failed'; return row
        row['read_status'] = 'returned'
        for key, allowed in {
            'connection':{'new','connecting','connected','disconnected','failed','closed'},
            'data_channel':{'connecting','open','closing','closed'},
            'audio_context_state':{'running','suspended','interrupted','closed','unknown'}}.items():
            row[key] = raw.get(key) if raw.get(key) in allowed else 'unknown'
        for key in ('sent_frames','buffer_gap_count','buffer_gap_frames','scheduled_queue_ms'):
            value = raw.get(key)
            row[key] = value if type(value) in (int, float) and 0 <= value <= 10**15 else None
        delivery = raw.get('datachannel_delivery')
        row['datachannel_delivery'] = {key:value if type(value := delivery.get(key)) is int
            and 0 <= value <= 10**15 else None for key in
            ('messages','json_errors','binding_attempted','binding_returned','binding_failed')} if isinstance(delivery, dict) else None
        row['outbound_audio'] = [{key:value if type(value := item.get(key)) is int and 0 <= value <= 10**15 else None
            for key in ('bytesSent','packetsSent')} for item in raw.get('reports', [])[:4] if isinstance(item, dict)]
    except TimeoutError:
        row['read_status'] = 'timeout'
    except Exception:
        row['read_status'] = 'failed'
    return row


def capture_owned(owned, browser, native):
    owned.add(getattr(getattr(native, 'rpc', None), 'process', None))
    for owner in (getattr(browser, 'playwright', None), getattr(browser, '_starter', None)):
        impl = getattr(owner, '_impl_obj', owner)
        connection = getattr(impl, '_connection', None)
        owned.add(getattr(getattr(connection, '_transport', None), '_proc', None))
    owned.snapshot()


def capture_owned_tasks(tasks, native):
    rpc = getattr(native, 'rpc', None)
    extras = [getattr(native, name, None) for name in (
        '_close_task', 'receiver', '_rx_task', '_question_task', '_tool_task',
        '_speech_task', '_phase_timeout')]
    extras += [getattr(rpc, '_close_task', None), *getattr(rpc, 'tasks', ())]
    for task in extras:
        if isinstance(task, asyncio.Task) and task not in tasks:
            tasks.append(task)


async def cleanup_probe(native, browser, owned, *, tasks, deadline=None, operation_task=None, before_stop=None):
    """One bounded cleanup window, preserving unknown protocol/close outcomes."""
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    deadline = loop.time() + CLEANUP_SECONDS if deadline is None else deadline
    soft_end = min(deadline, loop.time() + .8 * CLEANUP_SECONDS)
    unknown = False
    stop_result = 'not_started' if native is None else 'unknown'
    async def step(operation):
        nonlocal unknown
        task = asyncio.create_task(operation)
        tasks.append(task)
        try:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=max(0, soft_end - loop.time()))
            if task in done and not task.cancelled():
                return task.result()
        except BaseException:
            pass
        unknown = True; task.cancel()
        return None
    capture_owned(owned, browser, native)
    if before_stop is not None:
        await step(before_stop())  # Diagnostic shares this owned cleanup deadline.
    if native is not None:
        stop_result = await step(native.stop())
        if stop_result not in {'stopped', 'not_started'}:
            unknown = True
    if browser is not None:
        await step(browser.__aexit__(None, None, None))
    capture_owned(owned, browser, native)
    # Cancellation-finally may create further shielded RPC close work. Recheck
    # owned references on each loop; a single pre-cancel snapshot is insufficient.
    def collect():
        capture_owned_tasks(tasks, native)
        capture_owned(owned, browser, native)
    reaped, quiet = False, 0
    while loop.time() < deadline:
        collect()
        for task in tasks:
            if not task.done():
                unknown = True; task.cancel()
        if owned.live():
            unknown = True; owned.kill()
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        collect()
        reaped = (not owned.live()) if all(p.returncode is not None for p in owned.processes) else \
            await owned.reap(min(deadline, loop.time() + .002))
        pending = sum(not task.done() for task in tasks)
        quiet = quiet + 1 if reaped and not pending and not owned.live() else 0
        if quiet >= 2: break
        await asyncio.sleep(min(.001, max(0, deadline - loop.time())))
    collect()
    pending = sum(not task.done() for task in tasks)
    for task in tasks:
        if not task.done(): task.cancel()
        elif not task.cancelled(): task.exception()
    if owned.live(): owned.kill()
    unknown = unknown or not reaped or bool(pending) or bool(owned.live())
    return {'status':'unknown' if unknown else 'cleaned',
        'stop_status':stop_result or 'unknown',
        'stop_ack_received':getattr(native, 'stop_ack_received', None),
        'stop_closed_received':getattr(native, 'stop_closed_received', None),
        'native_cleanup_status':getattr(native, 'cleanup_status', None),
        'owned_processes':len(owned.processes), 'live_processes':len(owned.live()),
        'reaped':reaped, 'pending_close_tasks':pending,
        'pending_operation':operation_task is not None and not operation_task.done()}


def write_private_result(path, evidence, *, create=False):
    """Private text only, no audio/IDs; reserve exclusively, then atomic replace."""
    raw = (json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()
    if create:
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(raw); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    else:
        fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.qa-private-', dir=path.parent)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
                stream.write(raw); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            os.replace(temporary, path)
        finally:
            Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


async def run_probe(args):
    if not args.authorize_live:
        raise ValueError('explicit_live_authorization_required')
    private_path = getattr(args, 'private_result', None)
    if private_path is None:
        raise ValueError('private_result_path_required')
    private_path = Path(private_path)
    media_profile = getattr(args, 'peer_media_profile', 'legacy')
    if media_profile not in {'legacy','trusted-none'}:
        raise ValueError('unknown_peer_media_profile')
    qa_start_stage = getattr(args, 'qa_start_stage', 'wake')
    if qa_start_stage not in {'wake','question'}:
        raise ValueError('unknown_qa_start_stage')
    rtp_snapshots = []
    evidence = {'schema_version':1, 'kind':'private_synthetic_qa_evidence', 'rounds':[],
        'context_plans':[], 'context_plans_truncated':False,
        'timing_basis':'host monotonic seconds relative to probe start; send completion is not question end',
        'useful_text_criterion':'first assistant delta/final containing this round source budget term after question send begins',
        'audio_timing_unavailable':'scalar receiver energy does not identify useful speech or remote audibility',
        'control_receipt':None}
    write_private_result(private_path, evidence, create=True)  # Before any model/config I/O.
    started = time.monotonic()
    active_round = None
    assistant_delta = ''
    native = browser = None
    phase, checks, failure = 'config', [], None
    owned = OwnedProcesses()
    cleanup = None
    def capture_turn_lifecycle():
        try:
            getter = getattr(native, 'turn_lifecycle_snapshot', None)
            return getter() if callable(getter) else None
        except Exception:
            return None  # Missing optional evidence never replaces the real failure.
    def capture_speech_completion():
        try:
            getter = getattr(native, 'speech_completion_snapshot', None)
            return getter() if callable(getter) else None
        except Exception:
            return None
    async def capture_rtp_snapshot(label):
        if len(rtp_snapshots) < 5:
            rtp_snapshots.append(await probe_rtp_snapshot(native, label, started))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='native-qa-') as root:
        async def operation():
            nonlocal native, browser, phase, active_round, assistant_delta
            settings = load_assistant_settings(args.config)
            ice = load_ice_servers(args.ice_servers_file)
            phase = 'synthetic_input'
            wake = await asyncio.to_thread(synthetic_pcm, WAKE) if qa_start_stage == 'wake' else None
            question = await asyncio.to_thread(synthetic_pcm, QUESTION)
            store = MeetingStore(root)
            ident = 'synthetic-qa'
            store.create(ident)
            event = {'event_id': 'qa-source', 'revision': 1, 'text': '預算十萬元。',
                     'timestamp': '2026-10-11T00:00:00Z', 'sequence': 1}
            store.append_final(ident, event)
            class Source:
                async def read(self, meeting_id):
                    return await asyncio.to_thread(store.read,meeting_id)
            tool = MeetingMinutesTool(ident, MeetingStoreMinutesReader(Source()))
            phase = 'egress_guard'
            guard = RuntimeLiveGuard(ident, settings.allowed_egress_hosts, ice_servers=ice)
            await guard.prepare()
            phase = 'browser_open'
            browser = Browser(args.chromium)
            await browser.__aenter__()
            native = NativeLiveResponder(browser.browser, Path(root) / 'native-runtime', ident,
                ProbeTrackOutput(ident, NoPhysicalSink(), lambda: active_round
                    if phase.startswith('question_revision_') and native.state=='answering' else None), tool,
                executable=settings.codex_bin, guard=guard.adapter(), ice_servers=ice,
                wake_words=('小白小白', WAKE), question_timeout=30, muted_probe_text_gate=True, peer_media_profile=media_profile)
            prepare_context = native.context.prepare
            async def record_context(*args, **kwargs):
                plan = await prepare_context(*args, **kwargs)
                if len(evidence['context_plans']) < 8:
                    readings = plan.result['selected_source_reading']
                    evidence['context_plans'].append({'source_version':plan.result.get('version'),
                        'snapshot_sha256':plan.result['snapshot_sha256'],
                        'payload_sha256':hashlib.sha256(plan.payload.encode()).hexdigest(),
                        'reading_count':len(readings), 'readings_truncated':len(readings)>64,
                        'readings':[{'text_sha256':hashlib.sha256(row['text'].encode()).hexdigest(),
                            **{key:row[key] for key in ('revision','source_revision') if type(row.get(key)) is int}}
                            for row in readings[:64]],
                        'constructed_only':True, 'model_consumption_verified':False})
                else:
                    evidence['context_plans_truncated'] = True
                return plan
            native.context.prepare = record_context
            actual_start_params = getattr(native, 'live_start_params', None)
            if callable(actual_start_params):
                def record_start_params(offer):
                    params = actual_start_params(offer)
                    evidence['request'] = {'prompt':params['prompt'],
                        'prompt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(params['prompt'].encode()).hexdigest(),
                        'initialItems':params.get('initialItems', []),
                        'model':params['model'], 'version':params['version'],
                        'includeStartupContext':params['includeStartupContext'],
                        'transport_type':params['transport']['type'],
                        'diagnostic_mode':'synthetic_question_only' if qa_start_stage == 'question' else None,
                        'provider_wake_skipped':False,
                        'local_wake_skipped':qa_start_stage == 'question'}
                    return params
                native.live_start_params = record_start_params
            answers = []
            original = native.handle_notification
            async def capture(method, params):
                nonlocal assistant_delta
                received = time.monotonic() - started
                user_row = None
                if (active_round is not None and params.get('role') == 'user'
                        and method in {'thread/realtime/transcript/delta','thread/realtime/transcript/done'}):
                    text = params.get('delta' if method.endswith('/delta') else 'text', '')
                    if len(active_round['user_transcripts']) < 32:
                        user_row = {'kind':'delta' if method.endswith('/delta') else 'done',
                            'text':text[:2048], 'truncated':len(text) > 2048,
                            'received_seconds':received, 'phase':phase,
                            'state_before':native.state, 'state_after':None,
                            'wake_match':None,
                            'greeting_entered':False}
                        active_round['user_transcripts'].append(user_row)
                    else:
                        active_round['dropped_user_transcripts'] += 1
                late_greeting = (getattr(native, 'muted_probe_text_gate', False)
                    and method == 'thread/realtime/transcript/done'
                    and params.get('role') == 'assistant' and params.get('text', '').strip() == GREETING
                    and native.state != 'greeting')
                if active_round is not None and params.get('role') == 'assistant':
                    if method == 'thread/realtime/transcript/delta':
                        active_round['assistant_deltas'].append(
                            {'text':params.get('delta', ''), 'received_seconds':received, 'phase':phase})
                        assistant_delta += params.get('delta', '')
                        text = assistant_delta
                    elif method == 'thread/realtime/transcript/done':
                        text = params.get('text', '')
                        active_round['assistant_utterances'].append(
                            {'text':text, 'received_seconds':received, 'phase':phase,
                             'isolated_late_greeting':late_greeting})
                        if not late_greeting and active_round['timing']['question_send_begin_seconds'] is not None:
                            active_round['answer_text'] = text
                        assistant_delta = ''
                    else:
                        text = ''
                    timing = active_round['timing']
                    if (timing['question_send_begin_seconds'] is not None
                            and timing['first_useful_text_seconds'] is None
                            and active_round['expected_source_term'] in text):
                        timing['first_useful_text_seconds'] = received
                        active_round['first_useful_text_method'] = method
                await original(method, params)
                if user_row is not None:
                    user_row['state_after'] = native.state
                    user_row['wake_match'] = (
                        native.question_framer.pending_status()['has_wake']
                        if method.endswith('/delta') else None)
                    user_row['greeting_entered'] = user_row['state_before'] != 'greeting' and native.state == 'greeting'
                if not late_greeting and method == 'thread/realtime/transcript/done' and params.get('role') == 'assistant':
                    answers.append(params.get('text', ''))
            native.handle_notification = capture
            phase = 'qa_start'
            await native.start(enable_output=False)
            capture_owned(owned, browser, native)
            for revision, expected in ((1, '十萬元'), (2, '十二萬元')):
                if revision == 2:
                    store.append_final(ident, {**event, 'revision': 2, 'text': '預算十二萬元。'})
                snapshot=store.read(ident)
                source_text = '預算十萬元。' if revision == 1 else '預算十二萬元。'
                paragraph=next(record['text'] for record in snapshot['sources'] if record['text']==source_text)
                active_round = {'source_event_revision':revision, 'source_version':snapshot['version'],
                    'source_paragraph':paragraph,
                    'source_paragraph_sha256':hashlib.sha256(paragraph.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    'expected_source_term':expected, 'question':QUESTION,
                    'assistant_utterances':[], 'assistant_deltas':[], 'answer_text':None,
                    'user_transcripts':[], 'dropped_user_transcripts':0,
                    'first_useful_text_method':None,
                    'timing':{key:None for key in ('question_send_begin_seconds',
                        'question_send_complete_seconds', 'question_end_seconds',
                        'first_useful_text_seconds', 'first_nonzero_audio_seconds',
                        'first_useful_audio_seconds',
                        'first_useful_text_from_question_send_begin_seconds',
                        'first_useful_text_from_question_send_complete_seconds',
                        'first_useful_text_from_question_end_seconds',
                        'first_nonzero_audio_from_question_send_begin_seconds',
                        'first_nonzero_audio_from_question_send_complete_seconds',
                        'first_nonzero_audio_from_question_end_seconds')}}
                evidence['rounds'].append(active_round)
                assistant_delta = ''
                count, calls = len(answers), native.tool_calls
                if qa_start_stage == 'wake':
                    phase = 'wake_revision_' + str(revision)
                    await capture_rtp_snapshot('wake_before_send_' + str(revision))
                    await send_pcm(native, wake)
                    await capture_rtp_snapshot('wake_after_send_' + str(revision))
                    await wait_until(native, lambda: native.state == 'listening')
                    greeting = getattr(native, 'greeting_completion', None)
                else:
                    phase = 'question_admission_revision_' + str(revision)
                    active_round['question_admission'] = native.admit_synthetic_question_stage()
                    greeting = None
                active_round['greeting_completion'] = dict(greeting) if greeting else None
                phase = 'question_revision_' + str(revision)
                if qa_start_stage == 'question':
                    await capture_rtp_snapshot('question_before_send_' + str(revision))
                active_round['question_pcm'] = {'sha256':hashlib.sha256(question).hexdigest(),
                    'bytes':len(question), 'frames':len(question) // 2,
                    'sample_rate':24000, 'channels':1, 'format':'s16le'}
                active_round['timing']['question_send_begin_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
                await send_pcm(native, question)
                active_round['timing']['question_send_complete_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
                if qa_start_stage == 'question':
                    await capture_rtp_snapshot('question_after_send_' + str(revision))
                try:
                    await wait_until(native, lambda: native.state == 'sleeping' and native.tool_calls > calls)
                except PhaseWaitTimeout:
                    snapshot = getattr(native, 'speech_completion_snapshot', None)
                    active_round['question_timeout_snapshot'] = snapshot() if callable(snapshot) else None
                    raise
                utterances = answers[count:]
                active_round['turn_lifecycle'] = capture_turn_lifecycle()
                reply = utterances[-1] if utterances else ''
                question_utterances = [row['text'] for row in active_round['assistant_utterances']
                    if row['phase'] == phase and not row['isolated_late_greeting']]
                rx=answer_rx(active_round.get('audio_rx'))
                active_round['audio_rx_verdict']=rx
                checks.append({'source_revision': revision,
                    'audio_rx_verified':rx['verified'],'audio_rx':rx,
                    'exact_greeting': (bool(greeting and greeting['text_complete'] and greeting['local_lease_closed'])
                        or bool(utterances) and utterances[0].strip() == GREETING) if qa_start_stage == 'wake' else None,
                    'wake_validation':'attempted_unverified' if qa_start_stage == 'wake' else 'skipped_unverified',
                    'greeting_completion':dict(greeting) if greeting else None,
                    'scoped_tool_called': native.tool_calls > calls,
                    'expected_fact': expected in reply,
                    'exact_source_quote': (len(question_utterances) == 1
                        and question_utterances[0].strip() == paragraph),
                    'no_stale_fact': revision == 1 or '十萬元' not in reply.replace('十二萬元', ''),
                    'output_muted': not native.output.enabled,
                    'source_version': native.context.status()['source_version']})
            phase = 'checks_complete'
        operation_task = asyncio.create_task(operation())
        operation_task.add_done_callback(
            lambda task: None if task.cancelled() else task.exception())
        try:
            # asyncio.timeout/wait_for waits for cancellation to unwind. Native
            # start shields its own close, so supervise the task without awaiting
            # that unwind; cleanup owns it under the same bounded window.
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait({operation_task}, timeout=WORK_SECONDS)
            if operation_task not in done:
                raise WorkDeadlineExceeded()
            operation_task.result()
        except BaseException as error:
            failure = {'phase':phase, 'error_code':
                'work_deadline_exceeded' if isinstance(error, WorkDeadlineExceeded) else
                'phase_wait_timeout' if isinstance(error, PhaseWaitTimeout) else
                'probe_operation_timeout' if isinstance(error, TimeoutError) else 'probe_operation_failed',
                'exception_type':type(error).__name__}
            if isinstance(error, (WorkDeadlineExceeded, PhaseWaitTimeout)):
                failure['timeout_seconds'] = WORK_SECONDS if isinstance(error, WorkDeadlineExceeded) else error.seconds
                failure['timeout_layer'] = 'whole_work' if isinstance(error, WorkDeadlineExceeded) else 'phase_wait'
        finally:
            # Synchronous snapshot BEFORE cancellation/stop can erase live state,
            # including when the whole-work supervisor wins the question wait.
            speech_completion_before_stop = capture_speech_completion()
            if not operation_task.done():
                operation_task.cancel()
            # Context/greeting receipts survive start/wake/question failures and stop.
            greeting_before_stop = getattr(native, 'greeting_completion', None)
            greeting_before_stop = dict(greeting_before_stop) if greeting_before_stop else None
            if active_round is not None:
                active_round['greeting_completion'] = greeting_before_stop
            context_before_stop = native.context.status() if native is not None else None
            question_reader = getattr(native, 'question_receipts', None)
            question_before_stop = question_reader() if callable(question_reader) else None
            cleanup_deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + CLEANUP_SECONDS
            cleanup_tasks = [operation_task]
            cleanup_task = asyncio.create_task(cleanup_probe(native, browser, owned, tasks=cleanup_tasks,
                deadline=cleanup_deadline, operation_task=operation_task,
                before_stop=(lambda:capture_rtp_snapshot('failure_before_stop')) if failure else None))
            while not cleanup_task.done() and asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < cleanup_deadline:
                try:
                    await asyncio.wait({cleanup_task}, timeout=max(0,
                        cleanup_deadline - asyncio.get_running_loop().time()))
                except asyncio.CancelledError:
                    failure = failure or {'phase':'qa_cleanup', 'error_code':'cleanup_cancelled',
                                          'exception_type':'CancelledError'}
            if cleanup_task.done() and not cleanup_task.cancelled():
                try:
                    cleanup = cleanup_task.result()
                except BaseException:
                    pass
            if cleanup is None:
                cleanup_task.cancel()
                capture_owned_tasks(cleanup_tasks, native)
                for task in cleanup_tasks:
                    if not task.done(): task.cancel()
                capture_owned(owned, browser, native)
                owned.kill()
                live = owned.live()
                reaped = not live and all(p.returncode is not None for p in owned.processes)
                cleanup = {'status':'unknown', 'stop_status':getattr(native, 'stop_status', 'unknown'),
                    'stop_ack_received':getattr(native, 'stop_ack_received', None),
                    'stop_closed_received':getattr(native, 'stop_closed_received', None),
                    'native_cleanup_status':getattr(native, 'cleanup_status', None),
                    'owned_processes':len(owned.processes), 'live_processes':len(live),
                    'reaped':reaped, 'pending_close_tasks':sum(not task.done() for task in cleanup_tasks),
                    'pending_operation':not operation_task.done()}
        try:
            status_reader = getattr(native, 'status', None)
            rows = status_reader().get('tool_deliveries', []) if callable(status_reader) else []
        except Exception:
            rows = []
        evidence['context_deliveries'] = []
        for row in rows[-8:] if isinstance(rows, list) else []:
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                continue
            phase_value = row.get('phase')
            receipt = {'phase':phase_value if isinstance(phase_value, str) and phase_value in
                {'preparing','sending','delivered','failed','cancelled'} else 'unavailable'}
            for key in ('snapshot_sha256','payload_sha256'):
                value = row.get(key)
                receipt[key] = value if isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', value) else None
            for key in ('question_number','source_version','payload_bytes','sent_bytes','selected_ref_count'):
                value = row.get(key)
                receipt[key] = value if type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= 10**15 else None
            receipt['marker_returned'] = row.get('marker_returned') is True
            receipt['model_consumption_verified'] = False
            evidence['context_deliveries'].append(receipt)
        criteria = ['scoped_tool_called', 'expected_fact', 'exact_source_quote', 'no_stale_fact', 'output_muted','audio_rx_verified']
        if qa_start_stage == 'wake': criteria.append('exact_greeting')
        accepted = failure is None and len(checks) == 2 and all(
            all(c[key] for key in criteria) for c in checks)
        result = {'schema_version':2, 'kind':'synthetic_native_qa', 'checks':checks,
            'turn_lifecycle':capture_turn_lifecycle(),
            'speech_completion_before_stop':speech_completion_before_stop,
            'accepted':accepted and owned_cleanup_verified(cleanup),
            'owned_cleanup_verified':owned_cleanup_verified(cleanup),
            'failure':failure, 'last_phase':phase, 'work_limit_seconds':WORK_SECONDS,
            'qa_start_stage':qa_start_stage, 'acceptance_criteria':criteria,
            'wake_validation':'attempted_unverified' if qa_start_stage == 'wake' else 'skipped_unverified',
            'cleanup_limit_seconds':CLEANUP_SECONDS, 'stop_status':cleanup['stop_status'],
            'owned_cleanup':cleanup, 'greeting_completion':greeting_before_stop,
            'context_before_stop':context_before_stop,
            'question_receipts':question_before_stop,
            'question_timeout_snapshot':active_round.get('question_timeout_snapshot') if active_round is not None else None,
            'context':native.context.status() if native is not None else None,
            'teams_verified':False, 'physical_tx_verified':False,
            'media_diagnostics':{'profile':media_profile, 'rtp_snapshots':rtp_snapshots,
                'snapshot_limit':5, 'user_event_limit_per_round':32, 'user_text_limit_chars':2048,
                'user_transcript_events':sum(len(r['user_transcripts']) for r in evidence['rounds']),
                'wake_matches':sum(e['wake_match'] is True for r in evidence['rounds'] for e in r['user_transcripts']),
                'greeting_entries':sum(e['greeting_entered'] for r in evidence['rounds'] for e in r['user_transcripts']),
                'dropped_user_events':sum(r['dropped_user_transcripts'] for r in evidence['rounds']),
                'graph_prepare_status':(value if isinstance(value := getattr(getattr(native, 'peer', None), 'graph_prepare_status', None), str) and value in {'not_started','trusted_origin_entered','trusted_origin_failed','entered','failed','returned'} else None)}}
        for round_evidence in evidence['rounds']:
            timing = round_evidence['timing']
            text_time = timing['first_useful_text_seconds']
            for label in ('question_send_begin', 'question_send_complete'):
                origin = timing[label + '_seconds']
                if text_time is not None and origin is not None:
                    timing['first_useful_text_from_' + label + '_seconds'] = text_time - origin
        evidence['control_receipt'] = result.copy()
        digest = write_private_result(private_path, evidence)
        result['private_evidence'] = {'schema_version':1, 'written':True,
            'sha256':digest, 'round_count':len(evidence['rounds'])}
        return result


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--authorize-live', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--config', required=True, help='Existing authorized service YAML')
    parser.add_argument('--private-result', type=Path, help='New private JSON file (required before Live start)')
    parser.add_argument('--peer-media-profile', choices=('legacy','trusted-none'), default='legacy',
        help='Explicit media candidate; default preserves the existing graph')
    parser.add_argument('--qa-start-stage', choices=('wake','question'), default='wake',
        help='Explicit synthetic question diagnostic skips wake synthesis/validation; production gates unchanged')
    parser.add_argument('--chromium')
    parser.add_argument('--ice-servers-file')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        result = asyncio.run(run_probe(args))
    except Exception as error:
        # No provider error body, config, URL, SDP, token or original PCM output.
        print(json.dumps({'accepted': False, 'error_code':
            'authorization_required' if not args.authorize_live else 'synthetic_qa_probe_failed',
            'exception_type': type(error).__name__,
            'failure':{'phase':'authorization' if not args.authorize_live else 'probe_receipt_failed'},
            'context':None, 'stop_status':'not_started' if not args.authorize_live else 'unknown',
            'owned_cleanup':{'status':'not_started' if not args.authorize_live else 'unknown'}}))
        return 1
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0 if result['accepted'] else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
